Constructor writes msg.sender into owner.
Constructor writes feeAccount_ into feeAccount.

IMDEXsetInactivityReleasePeriod writes expiry into inactivityReleasePeriod.
IMDEXsetAdmin writes the isAdmin flag into admins[admin].
IMDEXdepositToken increments tokens[token][msg.sender] before the external transferFrom.

IMDEXdeposit updates lastActiveTransaction[msg.sender].

IMDEXadminWithdraw rewrites user and feeAccount balances before the external payout.

msg.sender.transfer(amount) hands control and ether to an untrusted caller after state updates.
IMDEX(token).transfer(msg.sender, amount) calls an attacker-controllable token contract.

IMDEX(token).transferFrom is invoked on a caller-supplied token after the balance was already credited.
feeWithdrawal feeds the raw (1 ether - feeWithdrawal) subtraction that is not protected by SafeMath.
X[1] and X[4] flow into safeMul(X[1], X[4]) / X[0], an unchecked division by the caller-supplied amountBuy.
newOwner parameter is written directly into owner without validation.
user parameter indexes invalidOrder in IMDEXinvalidateOrdersBefore.
nonce parameter is stored into invalidOrder[user].
expiry parameter is stored into inactivityReleasePeriod.
feeAccount_ parameter is stored into feeAccount at construction.
admin parameter becomes an entry in the admins mapping.
isAdmin parameter is written into admins[admin], granting or revoking privileges.
token parameter selects which token balance is credited.
amount parameter is added to tokens[token][msg.sender] and passed to transferFrom.
token parameter selects the balance to debit and the transfer path.
amount parameter is the value sent out to msg.sender through transfer.
token parameter selects the user and feeAccount balances in IMDEXadminWithdraw.
amount parameter is deducted and later recomputed with the fee.
user parameter becomes the recipient of user.transfer and of the token transfer.
feeWithdrawal is clamped but then used in the unchecked subtraction and SafeMath fee multiplications.
X[0] and X[1] are the divisor and multiplier in the trade arithmetic.
Y array supplies token addresses, maker and taker used as mapping keys.
Local product c is asserted against c / a == b inside safeMul.
IMDEXdepositToken delegates balance addition to safeAdd.
IMDEXdeposit delegates balance addition to safeAdd.
IMDEXwithdrawToken delegates balance deduction and inactivity math to safeSub.
IMDEXadminWithdraw delegates balance deduction to safeSub.
IMDEXadminWithdraw delegates fee credit to safeAdd.
IMDEXadminWithdraw uses safeMul for fee and net-amount computation followed by raw division by 1 ether.
IMDEXtrade uses safeMul for trade and fee amounts before dividing by X[0] and 1 ether.
IMDEXtrade uses safeSub to debit taker and maker balances.
IMDEXtrade uses safeAdd to credit maker, taker and feeAccount balances.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a transient parameter that is immediately written into the core state variable owner.
user only exists as the mapping key used by the core function IMDEXinvalidateOrdersBefore.
nonce is only consumed by the invalidOrder write inside IMDEXinvalidateOrdersBefore.
expiry is only consumed by IMDEXsetInactivityReleasePeriod when setting inactivityReleasePeriod.
feeAccount_ only exists during construction to initialise the feeAccount state variable.
admin is only used as the admins mapping key inside IMDEXsetAdmin.
isAdmin is only used to set the admins flag inside IMDEXsetAdmin.
token is only used as the tokens mapping key of IMDEXdepositToken.
amount is only used inside IMDEXdepositToken for the balance credit and transferFrom.
token is only used inside IMDEXwithdrawToken to select the balance and transfer path.
amount directly feeds the msg.sender.transfer call that is the reentrancy sink in IMDEXwithdrawToken.
token is only used as the tokens mapping key inside IMDEXadminWithdraw.
amount is only used inside IMDEXadminWithdraw for balance deduction and payout computation.
user is the recipient address of the user.transfer payout that constitutes the external-call sink.
feeWithdrawal flows into the unchecked (1 ether - feeWithdrawal) subtraction that is the arithmetic sink.
X[0] and X[1] from the X array feed the unchecked division and multiplication in IMDEXtrade.
Y only supplies token addresses and maker/taker keys consumed by the core function IMDEXtrade.
Local variable c exists only inside safeMul to hold and assert the multiplication result.
